summary: Cache inactive Sidebar membership projection indexes before per-input planning

replay.detail: Journal replay and action identities are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The unwired planner consumes a complete validated projection. All callers use the indexed contract. The bounded single-entry cache copies primitive arrangement identity/revision, membership frontier, scope, catalog revision and presentation revision keys. Hosts supply resolved.parents directly: each lookup checks completeness and parent values for at most 1024 folders, never scanning members on a valid hit. Invalidations delegate to full projection, which validates duplicate and wrong-container memberships before reporting missing resolved parents, matching Rust precedence. Incomplete or refused projections are never cached. Unrelated global snapshot writes retain the projection.

manual.detail: FRACTAL_SIDEBAR_PERF=1 opts into warm cached projection plus planning plus pending-state p95 <=4 ms and <=2x equivalent v1 component work; cold projection p50/p95 is reported separately. The v1 comparison includes production projection, move planning and optimistic arrangement update. Browser rendering, next-frame presentation and D-dependent real socket acceptance remain unmeasured.

recovery.detail: The cache is derived, in-memory and single-entry; no migration or rollback action is needed.
